question: Gugga Naumi festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Gugga Naumi:

 
 
• It is the festival of Haryana celebrated in the lunar month of Bhadon.
 
• It is connected with snake worship and is observed in August-September.
 
• It is a festival in honour of Gugga Pir, which also falls in Bhadon.
 
• The Pir's devotees paint his image on the wall in turmeric, also paint a snake in black, right in front of it, and then perform the ritual of worship.
 
• People also pour buttermilk into the holes of snakes.
 
• Sweet Sevian is the special dish of the festival.
